findings.message: WHEN OTHERS handler swallows the error: no re-raise, logging or use of SQLERRM/SQLCODE
findings.rationale: A catch-all handler that neither re-raises nor records the error hides failures from callers and from operators.
findings.fix_hint: Log the error and re-raise with RAISE, or handle specific exceptions.

findings.message: Dynamic SQL is built by string concatenation instead of bind variables
findings.rationale: Concatenating values into SQL text enables SQL injection and defeats cursor sharing.
findings.fix_hint: Use bind variables (USING / OPEN … FOR … USING); wrap identifiers with DBMS_ASSERT.

findings.message: SELECT INTO without NO_DATA_FOUND/TOO_MANY_ROWS handling in scope
findings.rationale: A single-row SELECT INTO raises when zero or several rows match; the error escapes to the caller unhandled.
findings.fix_hint: Add a handler for NO_DATA_FOUND and TOO_MANY_ROWS in the enclosing block, or use an explicit cursor.
